title: Implantation of an Artificial Endothelial Layer for Treatment of Chronic Corneal Edema

indication: Chronic corneal edema from endothelial failure in eyes with a previous, still attached DMEK lamella: case 1 pseudophakic bullous keratopathy in a 58-year-old woman (DMEK 5 years earlier for decompensation after anterior chamber lavage and pars plana vitrectomy for post-cataract endophthalmitis); case 2 primary graft failure in an 82-year-old man (DMEK for Fuchs dystrophy 2 years earlier, rebubbled once)

groups.description: Compassionate-use implantation of an artificial endothelial layer (EndoArt, investigational device): 9.0-mm descemetorhexis with a reverse Sinskey hook, implant injected with an IOL injector (Accuject) through a 2.4-mm incision, positioned on the posterior stroma, air then air mixed with 20% SF6, intraoperative OCT; antibiotic 1 week and long-term low-dose corticosteroid, no immunosuppression; University of Heidelberg

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of case 1 (Table 1 column 'Preoperatively'); swept-source OCT (Case 1 text)
series.notes: Table 1 columns 1 d (days/30.4375), 1 mo, 6 mo* (footnote: one day before the repositioning procedure), 6 mo† (footnote: one day after the repositioning procedure), 12 mo, 17 mo. Case 1 text: implant detachment found at the 6-month visit and repositioned with air a day later, so 6 mo* is 6 months and 6 mo† is 6 months + 2 days (6 + 2/30.4375). Values after the repositioning follow a second intervention.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of case 2 (Table 2 column 'Preoperatively'); OCT (swept-source OCT at follow-up; preoperative device not restated for case 2)
series.notes: Table 2 columns 1 d, 24 d* (footnote: one day before the repositioning procedure), 27 d† (footnote: two days after the repositioning procedure), 1 mo, 6 mo, 12 mo, 17 mo; days converted as days/30.4375. Case 2 text: implant detached inferiorly at 24 days and repositioned with air at 25 days. Values after the repositioning follow a second intervention.

notes: Two compassionate-use cases (per-eye values): kind individual, one series per case.

Role: the artificial endothelial layer is an investigational device, so the group is treated. Procedure context 'other': a synthetic endothelial implant after descemetorhexis, not a donor keratoplasty.

Both implants partially detached (case 1 at 6 months, case 2 at 24 days) and were repositioned with air; values after the repositioning are kept with their stated times, and the repositioning is a second intervention. Flagged for review.
Case 1 6 mo† time (6 months + 2 days) combines the Table 1 footnotes with the Case 1 text ('A day later, the lamella could be repositioned'); the table labels both columns '6 mo'.
Measurement method: the Case 1 text states CCT measured by swept-source OCT; Case 2 cites swept-source OCT images at follow-up; both recorded as 'oct'.

The case reports do not state explicitly how the attached previous DMEK lamella was handled; the general technique describes a 9.0-mm descemetorhexis removing the patient's Descemet membrane and endothelium.
